articles.title: What is a supernode, and why does it matter for the China-US tech rivalry?
articles.summary: The emergence of "supernodes," which integrate hundreds or thousands of chips to function as a single supercomputer, marks a pivotal advancement in AI technology, underscoring the intensifying China-US tech rivalry as both nations race to dominate the next generation of artificial intelligence infrastructure. This breakthrough not only enhances computational power but also signifies a strategic shift in how countries approach AI development and deployment.
